janvier_by_verse.7: And he said to him: I am the Lord that brought thee out from Ur of the Chaldees for to give thee this land, and that thou mightest possess it.
janvier_by_verse.8: But he said: Lord God, how may I know that I shall possess it?
janvier_by_verse.9: And our Lord answered, and said: Take me a cow of three years old, and a she goat of three years, and a ram of three years, a turtle also, and a pigeon.
janvier_by_verse.10: Who taking all these, divided them by the midst, and laid each two pieces arow one against the other: but the birds he divided not.
janvier_by_verse.11: And the fowls lighted upon the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
janvier_by_verse.12: And when the sun was setting, a deep sleep fell upon Abram, and a great and darksome horror invaded him.
janvier_by_verse.13: And it was said unto him: Know and foreknow that a pilgrim shall thy seed be in a land not their own (and they shall bring them under bondage, and afflict them) four hundred years.
janvier_by_verse.14: But the Nation, whom they shall serve, I will judge: and after this they shall go forth with great substance.
janvier_by_verse.15: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace, buried in a good old age.
janvier_by_verse.16: But in the fourth generation they shall return hither: for as yet the iniquities of the Amorrheans are not at the full until this present time.
janvier_by_verse.17: Therefore when the sun was set, there arose a dark mist, and there appeared a furnace smoking, and a flake of fire passing between those divisions.
janvier_by_verse.18: That day God made a covenant with Abram, saying: To thy seed will I give this land from the river of Ægypt even to the great river Euphrates.
janvier_by_verse.19: the Cineans, and Cenezeites, the Cedmonites,
janvier_by_verse.20: and the Hethits, and the Pherezits, the Raphaims also,
janvier_by_verse.21: and the Amorreans and the Chananites, and Gargasites, and the Jebusites.
